About Rice's Fried Chicken & Seafood

Rice's Fried Chicken & Seafood, located at 1612 Broadway St, Houston, TX 77012, is a must-visit spot for anyone craving deliciously prepared fried chicken and seafood. This vibrant eatery offers a flavorful dining experience with a focus on fresh, high-quality ingredients and exceptional seasoning that will surely leave you coming back for more.

The fried chicken at Rice's stands out with its crispy exterior and tender, juicy meat. Each bite offers the perfect balance of crunch and tenderness, and the seasoning adds a delicious depth of flavor that enhances the overall experience. Whether you're a fried chicken aficionado or new to the dish, Rice's version is sure to impress.

The seafood menu is equally impressive. The fish is always fresh, cooked to perfection, and seasoned just right, delivering a delightful burst of flavors with each bite. From fried fish to other seafood options, the quality and taste are consistently top-notch, making it a great choice for seafood lovers.

One of the standout aspects of Rice's Fried Chicken & Seafood is its commitment to freshness. Each meal is made to order, ensuring that you receive your food hot and crispy. This attention to detail is reflected in both the chicken and seafood, which arrive perfectly cooked and full of flavor.

The friendly and attentive staff create a welcoming atmosphere, ensuring that each customer enjoys a pleasant dining experience. Whether you're grabbing a quick bite or enjoying a relaxed meal with friends or family, the service is quick and the staff is always ready to accommodate your needs.

Rice's Fried Chicken & Seafood offers a perfect balance of great food, excellent service, and a cozy environment. It’s a great spot for those looking to enjoy tasty comfort food, from crispy fried chicken to flavorful seafood, all served up with a smile.

Rice's Fried Chicken & Seafood

Rice's Fried Chicken & Seafood - Enjoy crispy and tender fried chicken and flavorful seafood at this cozy and trendy restaurant in Houston, TX. Perfect for a quick bite or a relaxed dinner, with options for takeaway, delivery, and dine-in. The menu includes individual orders and family packages of fried chicken, as well as a variety of side orders like french fries, chicken tenders, and sandwiches. Don't miss out on the delicious, perfectly seasoned meals that keep customers like 'david Jimenez' and 'Shardae Coruthers' coming back for more!
